How studio owners decide to add a service: a qualitative study

Abstract
We conducted semi-structured interviews with 21 owners and used thematic analysis.

1. Introduction
Paragraph 1 on owner decisions describes the setting in plain terms. Prior studies report mixed evidence on this question (Smith, 2019; Jones and Lee, 2021). We keep the units of observation distinct and report each step with its sample size.

2. Methods
We ran semi-structured interviews lasting 45 to 70 minutes. Two coders built a coding scheme and used thematic analysis. The interview protocol was preregistered on Zenodo after an initial look at the data. Paragraph 1 on coding describes the setting in plain terms. Prior studies report mixed evidence on this question (Smith, 2019; Jones and Lee, 2021). We keep the units of observation distinct and report each step with its sample size.

3. Results

Paragraph 1 on themes and theory describes the setting in plain terms. Prior studies report mixed evidence on this question (Smith, 2019; Jones and Lee, 2021). We keep the units of observation distinct and report each step with its sample size.

5. Conclusion
Owners add services when cash timing allows.
